column1: # Hand-written layout cases for NorthPost Parser.
# Each section writes the same kind of address in a different layout: where the unit sits, which lines are
# present, and so on. The ODA and NAR bulk tests build every address in one layout, so they cannot see these.
# The addresses are invented. A person wrote the expected values; they are what the parser should return, not a
# record of what it returned. LayoutAddressTest checks every column exactly, so an empty column means the field
# must be empty.
address
